QUOTE: In `response_generator.cpp:410-420`, the observer thread writes a non-atomic `cancel_int`. The pollers in `inference_c_api.cpp` and `interface_factory.cpp` read it through an `int*`. That is a data race under the C++ memory model... The fix is to make the cancel word an `std::atomic<int>`, or to pass an atomic flag across the boundary.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer treats the plain int as a data-race bug to fix, not as the deliberate reason the observer thread exists (bridging an atomic to a plain int because the C ABI can't carry an atomic).
